geographic_bounds._disclosure: PTF-CHATTANOOGA-TN-NEW-MARKET-001 discovery bounding box for the Greater Chattanooga traveler lodging market. Covers Hamilton County, Tennessee -- Chattanooga proper, the downtown/riverfront core, the Southside, St Elmo and Lookout Mountain TN, Lookout Valley/Tiftonia on I-24 west, East Ridge at I-75 exit 1, Brainerd, the Hamilton Place / Shallowford Road / Chattanooga Metropolitan Airport cluster at I-75 exit 5, North Shore, Red Bank, Signal Mountain, Hixson, Soddy-Daisy, Harrison, Ooltewah at I-75 exit 11, Collegedale and Apison. The SOUTHERN edge (34.90) reaches past the Tennessee/Georgia state line at 34.9829 DELIBERATELY: Fort Oglethorpe, Ringgold and the Battlefield Parkway lodging cluster in Catoosa and Walker counties, Georgia sit inside the box, and any lodging found there is a DISCOVERY LEAD ONLY, classified NORTH_GEORGIA_FRINGE_HOLD or OUTSIDE_MARKET by the market contract, which admits Tennessee municipalities only. A north-Georgia hotel marketing itself as 'Chattanooga' is not admitted by that prose. This box does not overlap any committed discovery box: every other registered market lies north of latitude 37.9 or is in Ohio, Michigan, Pennsylvania, Indiana, Kentucky, Missouri or Wisconsin territory. Overlap in a discovery box would in any case be harmless -- ownership is decided per identity by the market contract and MARKET_ID_FIELD, never by which box a coordinate falls in.

coordinate_precision_disclosure: All lat/lng values in this file are low-precision (~2-4 decimal places) approximate municipal-center reference points from general public geographic knowledge. They are seed points for bounded-radius provider queries and for the local OSM extract bbox only; nothing downstream treats them as survey-grade.
